name: Giovanni Trovato
title: Senior Mobile / Platform Engineer
subtitle: iOS · Android · CI/CD · Mobile Device Management
availability: EU citizen · unrestricted German work authorization · available immediately
profile: Senior mobile and platform engineer with 11+ years delivering native iOS and Android products, including eight years in enterprise mobility and device management. Owns the app lifecycle end to end — architecture, code and security review, automated quality, CI/CD, signing, store delivery and platform certification. Six years as technical owner of an iOS MDM client used by hundreds of corporate customers across tens of thousands of managed devices, with direct technical coordination across product, QA, Apple and Google.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Software Engineer / Technical Owner, iOS & Android
relevant_experience.summary: Enterprise mobility and device management (MDM, secure printing) in a mobile team of 3–7 engineers.
highlights: Expanded the Android test suite to ~4,800 tests and raised UI-test coverage from 15% to 82%, while cutting CI test runtime by 75% (32 to 8 minutes) to give the team same-hour merge feedback.

Technical owner of the Cortado MDM iOS client for six years from its first commit — owned architecture, release decisions and code review, coordinating delivery with product, QA and backend while mentoring mobile colleagues.

Led annual iOS compatibility and platform beta validation, including Swift 6 concurrency and iOS 26 migrations; coordinated directly with Apple on App Review while adopting Dynamic Island, Live Activities, Siri and App Intents without dropping older-device support.

Migrated nearly every Android screen from XML to Jetpack Compose, including kiosk mode, adding unit tests throughout; also managed Android Enterprise Partner Program certifications and worked directly with Google on platform issues.

Owned delivery and security across both platforms: code and vulnerability reviews, GitLab CI/CD and Fastlane, signing and provisioning, security scans and SBOM generation, TestFlight and Play Store staged rollout.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Developer
relevant_experience.summary: B2B sales-automation platform for enterprise field sales teams.
highlights: Built native iOS and Android features with an offline-first architecture, keeping field sales teams productive without connectivity.
Created a reusable UI component library and led a UI/UX redesign of the mobile clients, reducing duplicate implementation work across new screens.
Resolved production defects and performance issues for enterprise customers across iOS (Swift, Objective-C) and Android (Java) with REST back ends.

relevant_experience.title: Mobile Developer Intern
relevant_experience.summary: Built production Android augmented-reality applications for manufacturing and automotive clients using Java, Vuforia and Wikitude.

Thesis on a capacitive sensor system — custom hardware, firmware and analysis software.
